name: Rosey
title: Currently teaching A-level Physics at a top sixth-form college · AQA specialist
bio: Rosey currently teaches A-level Physics at a top sixth-form college and has been teaching for several years. She is extremely popular with her students and highly regarded by her fellow teachers.

Because she teaches the AQA specification every week, her lessons are built around what earns marks on the AQA papers: setting out multi-step calculations so the method marks are safe, the required practicals and the Paper 3 data-analysis questions, the definitions AQA asks for word for word, and the six-mark extended responses.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for Year 12 (AS) and Year 13 (A level), at a regular weekly slot
Topic-by-topic teaching of anything that hasn't clicked in class, from particles and waves to fields and the Paper 3 options
Past-paper questions marked against the AQA mark schemes, with feedback on where the marks went
Mock-paper walk-throughs before the May and June exams
